<script>
    const API_SQL_URL = "DataService2.aspx/ExecuteSQL";

    $(document).ready(function () {
        // 1. 切換頁籤事件 (5 個頁籤對齊)
        $('button[data-bs-toggle="tab"]').on('shown.bs.tab', function (e) {
            const targetTab = $(e.target).attr('data-bs-target');
            if (targetTab === '#tab-multi') searchMultiResonance();
            if (targetTab === '#tab-radar') loadIntradayRadar();
            if (targetTab === '#tab-dna') loadDNAndFundamentals();
            if (targetTab === '#tab-macro') loadMacroCalendar();

            if (targetTab === '#tab-charts') {
                setTimeout(function () {
                    const iframe = document.getElementById('iframe-charts');
                    if (iframe && iframe.contentWindow) {
                        try { iframe.contentWindow.scrollTo(0, 0); } catch (e) { }
                    }
                }, 300);
            }
        });

        // 2. 預設進入第一頁：🎯 全市場多維共振
        searchMultiResonance();

        // 3. 👑【Magic Click 智慧萬用版】：自動掃描整列所有欄位，只要有 4 位數股號 100% 自動跳轉與開圖！
        $(document).on('click', 'table tbody tr', function (e) {
            // A. 防誤觸：點擊按鈕、連結、輸入框或表頭 (thead) 時不觸發跳轉
            if ($(e.target).is('button, a, input, select, th') || $(this).parents('thead').length > 0) return;

            // B. 智慧掃描：遍歷該列的所有 td，自動尋找 4 位數股票代號 (如 2615, 3034, 2330)
            let stockCode = "";
            $(this).find('td').each(function() {
                const txt = $(this).text().trim();
                if (txt.match(/^\d{4}$/)) {
                    stockCode = txt;
                    return false; // 找到代號立即中斷搜尋
                }
            });

            // C. 找到股號 ➔ 執行跳轉與繪圖
            if (stockCode) {
                console.log("🎯 點擊股票代號: " + stockCode + " ➔ 正在切換圖表中心並發動【盤後聯動查詢】...");

                // 切換至「頁籤 3 (四大聯動圖表中心)」
                const chartTabBtn = document.getElementById('charts-tab');
                if (chartTabBtn) {
                    var tabInst = new bootstrap.Tab(chartTabBtn);
                    tabInst.show();
                } else {
                    $('#charts-tab').tab('show');
                }

                // 高穩定度輪詢對焦：定位 iframe 填入代號並點擊「盤後聯動 (歷史)」
                let attempts = 0;
                const checkIframeAndRun = setInterval(function() {
                    attempts++;
                    const iframe = document.getElementById('iframe-charts');
                    
                    if (iframe && iframe.contentWindow && iframe.contentWindow.document) {
                        const stockInput = iframe.contentWindow.document.getElementById('keyword');
                        const btnPost = iframe.contentWindow.document.getElementById('btn_query_post');

                        if (stockInput && btnPost) {
                            clearInterval(checkIframeAndRun); // 成功定位，停止輪詢
                            
                            stockInput.value = stockCode;
                            console.log("✅ 已自動更新圖表輸入框代號為: " + stockCode);

                            btnPost.click(); // 自動觸發盤後聯動查詢！

                            try {
                                iframe.contentWindow.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
                            } catch(err) {}
                        }
                    }

                    if (attempts >= 10) {
                        clearInterval(checkIframeAndRun);
                    }
                }, 300);
            }
        });
    });

    // 🎯 頁籤 1 數據：0ms 多維共振極速掃描
    function searchMultiResonance() {
        const hitCount = $("#selHitCount").val() || 3;
        const momentumMode = $("#selMomentumMode").val() || 2;

        const sql = `SELECT TOP 100
            [代號], [名稱], [盤中成交價] AS [現價], [盤中漲幅] AS [漲幅%], [盤中總量] AS [總量],
            [HitCount] AS [共振維度數], [ResonanceTag] AS [共振等級],
            [DimA_Status] AS [雙動能狀態], [DimB_Status] AS [OBV星號狀態], [DimC_Status] AS [價格星號狀態], [DimD_Status] AS [彩虹金叉狀態]
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.ResonanceMultiFactor_Snapshot
        WHERE [HitCount] >= ${hitCount}
          AND (${momentumMode} = 0 OR [DimA_DualMomentum] = ${momentumMode})
        ORDER BY [HitCount] DESC, [DimD_RainbowScore] DESC, [盤中總量] DESC;`;

        execQueryToTable(sql, "stockchangedate", "#tblMultiResonance");
    }

    // 🔄 手動刷新快照程序
    function refreshResonanceSnapshot() {
        if (typeof Swal !== 'undefined') {
            Swal.fire({ title: '⏳ 正在重構全市場多維共振快照...', text: '約需 1 秒，請稍候', allowOutsideClick: false, didOpen: () => { Swal.showLoading(); } });
        }
        
        $.ajax({
            type: "POST",
            url: API_SQL_URL,
            data: JSON.stringify({ sql: "EXEC stockchangedate.dbo.sp_RefreshMultiResonanceSnapshot;", db: "stockchangedate", pwd: "2157" }),
            contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
            dataType: "json",
            success: function () {
                if (typeof Swal !== 'undefined') Swal.fire('成功', '全市場多維共振快照已重構完成！', 'success');
                searchMultiResonance();
            }
        });
    }

    // 🌐 頁籤 2 數據：盤中雷達 ✕ 自選股 28/29 (已將代號調至第一欄)
    function loadIntradayRadar() {
        const sqlRadar = `SELECT TOP 30
            C.[代號], C.[股票] AS [名稱], C.[盤中成交價] AS [現價], C.[漲幅_百分比] AS [漲幅%], C.[盤中總量] AS [總量],
            ROUND(C.[預估今日總分], 2) AS [預估總分], C.[細產業名稱] AS [產業]
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.IntradayScoreCache C
        WHERE C.[盤中總量] >= 500
        ORDER BY C.[預估今日總分] DESC;`;

        execQueryToTable(sqlRadar, "stockchangedate", "#tblIntradayRadar");

        // 🛠️ 欄位順序對齊：代號, 名稱 放前兩欄
        const sql2829 = `SELECT TOP 30
            代號, 名稱, 分組, ROUND([60M動能(OSC)], 2) AS [60M_OSC], 短線氣象
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar
        WHERE 分組 IN (N'自選股28', N'自選股29')
        ORDER BY 分組 DESC, [60M動能(OSC)] DESC;`;

        execQueryToTable(sql2829, "stockchangedate", "#tblWatchlist2829");
    }

    // 💎 頁籤 4 數據：3-Way 離場勝率快照 ✕ FactSet 法人目標價
    function loadDNAndFundamentals() {
        const sql3Exits = `SELECT TOP 50
            [代號], [名稱], [完成交易次數], 
            [Return_5MA] AS [5MA期望值%], [Return_10MA] AS [10MA期望值%], [Return_20MA] AS [20MA期望值%], 
            [OptimalExit] AS [最適建議]
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality_3Exits
        ORDER BY [Return_20MA] DESC;`;

        execQueryToTable(sql3Exits, "stockchangedate", "#tbl3Exits");

        const sqlGems = `SELECT TOP 50
            RTRIM(F.代號) AS [代號],
            ISNULL(M.名稱, F.代號) AS [名稱],
            ISNULL(M.盤中現價, 0) AS [現價],
            ISNULL(R.最新公告營收年增, 0) AS [營收年增%],
            ISNULL(FN.EPS累計, 0) AS [半年報EPS],
            F.預估目標價 AS [FactSet目標價],
            ROUND(((F.預估目標價 - ISNULL(M.盤中現價, F.舊EPS中位數)) / NULLIF(ISNULL(M.盤中現價, F.舊EPS中位數), 0)) * 100, 1) AS [潛在空間%]
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates F
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT 代號, 名稱, 盤中現價, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
            FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis
            WHERE 盤中現價 > 0
        ) M ON RTRIM(F.代號) = RTRIM(M.代號) AND M.rn = 1
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT 代號, 最新公告營收年增, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 交易日期 DESC) AS rn
            FROM stockchangedate.dbo.View_Realtime_Revenue
        ) R ON RTRIM(F.代號) = RTRIM(R.代號) AND R.rn = 1
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT 代號, EPS累計, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
            FROM stockchangedate.dbo.financesum
        ) FN ON RTRIM(F.代號) = RTRIM(FN.代號) AND FN.rn = 1
        WHERE F.預估目標價 > 0
        ORDER BY ROUND(((F.預估目標價 - ISNULL(M.盤中現價, F.舊EPS中位數)) / NULLIF(ISNULL(M.盤中現價, F.舊EPS中位數), 0)) * 100, 1) DESC;`;

        execQueryToTable(sqlGems, "stockchangedate", "#tblFundamentalGems");
    }

    // 📅 頁籤 5 數據：全球重大總經日曆
    function loadMacroCalendar() {
        const sqlMacro = `SELECT TOP 50
            [公布日期], [公布時間] AS [時間], [國家區域], [指標類別], [指標名稱], [重要性], [前值], [預測值], ISNULL([實際值], N'⏳ 待公布') AS [實際值], [影響解讀]
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MacroEconomicCalendar
        WHERE [公布日期] >= 20260101
        ORDER BY [公布日期] ASC, [公布時間] ASC;`;

        execQueryToTable(sqlMacro, "stockchangedate", "#tblMacroCalendar");
    }

    // 🛠️ 通用數據連線與 DataTables 安全引擎
    function execQueryToTable(sql, db, tableSelector) {
        console.log("📡 正在執行 AJAX 查詢 [" + tableSelector + "]...");
        $.ajax({
            type: "POST",
            url: API_SQL_URL,
            data: JSON.stringify({ sql: sql, db: db, pwd: "2157" }),
            contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
            dataType: "json",
            timeout: 300000,
            success: function (res) {
                try {
                    let dataStr = res.d;
                    if (!dataStr) return;

                    if (dataStr.startsWith("錯誤：")) {
                        $(tableSelector).html(`<tbody><tr><td class="text-danger p-3">❌ SQL 錯誤: ${dataStr}</td></tr></tbody>`);
                        return;
                    }

                    const cleanedJson = dataStr.replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F-\u009F]/g, function(ch) {
                        if (ch === '\n') return '\\n';
                        if (ch === '\r') return '\\r';
                        if (ch === '\t') return '\\t';
                        return '';
                    });

                    const data = JSON.parse(cleanedJson);
                    if (!data || data.length === 0) {
                        $(tableSelector).html(`<tbody><tr><td class="text-warning p-3">✅ 暫無符合條件數據。</td></tr></tbody>`);
                        return;
                    }

                    renderDataTable(data, tableSelector);
                } catch (e) {
                    $(tableSelector).html(`<tbody><tr><td class="text-danger p-3">❌ JSON 解析失敗: ${e.message}</td></tr></tbody>`);
                }
            },
            error: function () {
                $(tableSelector).html(`<tbody><tr><td class="text-danger p-3">❌ 連線 DataService2.aspx 失敗！</td></tr></tbody>`);
            }
        });
    }

    function renderDataTable(data, tableSelector) {
        if (!data || data.length === 0) return;

        if ($.fn.DataTable.isDataTable(tableSelector)) {
            $(tableSelector).DataTable().clear().destroy();
        }

        $(tableSelector).empty();

        let keys = Object.keys(data[0]);
        let thead = "<thead><tr>" + keys.map(k => `<th>${k}</th>`).join('') + "</tr></thead>";
        let tbody = "<tbody>";
        data.forEach(row => {
            tbody += "<tr>";
            keys.forEach(k => { 
                let val = (row[k] !== null && row[k] !== undefined) ? row[k] : '';
                tbody += `<td>${val}</td>`; 
            });
            tbody += "</tr>";
        });
        tbody += "</tbody>";

        $(tableSelector).html(thead + tbody);

        $(tableSelector).DataTable({
            "language": { "url": "//cdn.datatables.net/plug-ins/1.13.6/i18n/zh-HANT.json" },
            "pageLength": 10,
            "order": [],
            "scrollCollapse": true,
            "destroy": true
        });
    }
</script>

' 🛠️【StockAI.aspx.vb】智慧提取 4 位數股號與意圖分流
Public Shared Function ParseSpeechIntent(ByVal userPrompt As String) As String
    Dim stockCode As String = ""
    ' 1. 使用正則表達式尋找 4 位數股票代號
    Dim match As Match = Regex.Match(userPrompt, "\b\d{4}\b")
    If match.Success Then
        stockCode = match.Value
    End If

    ' 2. 判斷意圖關鍵字 (Unicode N 前綴模糊比對)
    If userPrompt.Contains("說明") OrElse userPrompt.Contains("診斷") OrElse userPrompt.Contains("解盤") Then
        Return ExecuteChartExplain(stockCode) ' 觸發全套四大圖表 + Qwen-7B 解盤
    ElseIf userPrompt.Contains("離場") OrElse userPrompt.Contains("勝率") OrElse userPrompt.Contains("基因") Then
        Return Execute3ExitsQuery(stockCode)  ' 觸發 3-Way 離場勝率對照
    ElseIf userPrompt.Contains("目標價") OrElse userPrompt.Contains("財報") OrElse userPrompt.Contains("EPS") Then
        Return ExecuteFactSetQuery(stockCode) ' 觸發 FactSet 估值查詢
    ElseIf userPrompt.Contains("股票代號") OrElse userPrompt.Contains("概念") Then
        Return ExecuteConceptQuery(stockCode) ' 觸發概念與代號對照
    Else
        Return ExecuteDefaultStockAnalysis(stockCode) ' 預設四圖分析
    End If
End Function

--- ### 🛠️ 後端 `StockAI.aspx.vb` 智慧解析中文股名 ➔ 自動轉代號 為了讓後台能同時聽懂 `台積電 說明`、`聯發科 離場`、`鴻海`： 我們在 VB.NET 後台加入 「中文股票名稱 ➔ 自動對照 4 位數代號」 的轉換函數。即使使用者不知代號，系統也能自動轉成 `2330`、`2454`、`2317`：
vb
' =========================================================================
' 🛠️【StockAI.aspx.vb】智慧提取：支援「4位數代號」或「中文股票名稱」+ 意圖關鍵字
' =========================================================================
Public Shared Function ParseStockCodeOrName(ByVal userPrompt As String) As String
    Dim stockCode As String = ""
    userPrompt = userPrompt.Trim()

    ' 1. 優先用正則表達式尋找 4 位數股票代號 (如 2330, 2408)
    Dim matchCode As Match = Regex.Match(userPrompt, "\b\d{4}\b")
    If matchCode.Success Then
        Return matchCode.Value
    End If

    ' 2. 若無 4 位數代號，向 MasterStockAnalysis 查詢中文名稱對應的代號 (例如 '台積電' -> '2330')
    Dim connStr As String = "Data Source=PC048000110;Initial Catalog=stockchangedate;Integrated Security=True;"
    Dim sql As String = "SELECT TOP 1 RTRIM(代號) FROM dbo.MasterStockAnalysis WHERE @Prompt LIKE N'%' + RTRIM(名稱) + N'%' ORDER BY 日期 DESC"

    Try
        Using conn As New SqlConnection(connStr)
            Using cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Prompt", userPrompt)
                conn.Open()
                Dim obj = cmd.ExecuteScalar()
                If obj IsNot DBNull.Value AndAlso obj IsNot Nothing Then
                    stockCode = obj.ToString().Trim()
                End If
            End Using
        End Using
    Catch ex As Exception
        ' 紀錄異常
    End Try

    Return stockCode
End Function

def insert_nomura_expert_stocks():
    """優先寫入/更新野村研報的 35 檔重點專家台廠資料"""
    current_date = time.strftime("%Y%m%d")
    print("\n🔥 [第一階段] 優先注入 Nomura 野村研報 35 檔 AI 伺服器專家基因 (10~15 標籤)...")
    
    count = 0
    try:
        with engine.begin() as conn:
            for name, concepts in NOMURA_EXPERT_STOCKS.items():
                # 先刪除舊的 AI 生成標籤或舊專家標籤
                conn.execute(text("DELETE FROM dbo.notioninfo WHERE mail1 = :name"), {"name": name})
                
                # 插入野村研報極致專家標籤
                insert_sql = text(f"""
                    INSERT INTO {TARGET_TABLE} (name1, mail1, word1, 時間戳記)
                    VALUES (:concepts, :name, :word, :ts)
                """)
                conn.execute(insert_sql, {
                    "concepts": concepts, 
                    "name": name, 
                    "word": f"{name}(Nomura野村研報+Expert)", 
                    "ts": current_date
                })
                count += 1
                print(f"   └─ 👑 [Nomura專家] {name}: {concepts}")
        print(f"✅ 完成 {count} 檔 Nomura 專家股 10~15 標籤強效注入！\n")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 注入 Nomura 專家股失敗: {e}\n")

def get_stocks_to_upgrade():
    """
    找出需要 Ollama 自動升級標籤的股票：
    1. 條件：標籤數少於 8 個 (即 '|' 少於 7 個)
    2. 排除 Expert 手動與 Nomura 野村研報維護的資料
    """
    sql = """
    SELECT DISTINCT RTRIM(M.名稱) as 名稱 
    FROM dbo.MasterStockAnalysis M
    LEFT JOIN dbo.notioninfo N ON RTRIM(M.名稱) = RTRIM(N.mail1)
    WHERE (
          N.word1 IS NULL -- 完全沒資料
          OR (
              N.word1 LIKE '%Ollama%' -- 之前由 AI 產生的
              AND (LEN(N.name1) - LEN(REPLACE(N.name1, '|', '')) < 7) -- 標籤數少於 8 個
          )
      )
      AND (N.word1 NOT LIKE '%Expert%' OR N.word1 IS NULL) -- 絕對不碰手動修改/Nomura專家的
    """
    try:
        return pd.read_sql(sql, engine)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 讀取資料庫失敗: {e}")
        return pd.DataFrame()

def ask_ollama_v3(names_str):
    """呼叫 Ollama 生成 8 至 12 個高價值極致標籤"""
    prompt = f"""
    你現在是台股產業百科全書與供應鏈專家。請針對名單，給出它們2026年最核心且完整的 8 到 12 個題材標籤。
    
    標籤選取優先權：
    1. 供應鏈客戶（如：谷歌TPU、輝達GPU、超微AMD、亞馬遜AWS、微軟、特斯拉Dojo、戴爾）
    2. 關鍵零組件與角色（如：AI伺服器ODM、高階機殼、BBU、水冷板ColdPlate、CDU、CPO矽光子、ABF載板、CCL、探針卡）
    3. 產業地位與技術（如：半導體代工龍頭、CoWoS先進封測、800G交換器、FOPLP、高階HDI）
    
    格式要求：『名稱:標籤1 | 標籤2 | 標籤3 | 標籤4 | 標籤5 | 標籤6 | 標籤7 | 標籤8 | 標籤9 | 標籤10』

    名單：{names_str}
    """
    
    payload = {"model": MODEL_NAME, "prompt": prompt, "stream": False}
    try:
        response = requests.post(OLLAMA_URL, json=payload, timeout=120)
        return response.json().get('response', '')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ Ollama 連線失敗: {e}")
        return ""

def clean_and_insert(name, concepts):
    """執行先刪後補，維持一檔一列"""
    current_date = time.strftime("%Y%m%d")
    try:
        with engine.begin() as conn:
            conn.execute(text("DELETE FROM dbo.notioninfo WHERE mail1 = :name AND word1 NOT LIKE '%Expert%'"), {"name": name})
            
            insert_sql = text(f"""
                INSERT INTO {TARGET_TABLE} (name1, mail1, word1, 時間戳記)

            """)
            conn.execute(insert_sql, {

                "word": f"{name}(Ollama補全10+)", 
                "ts": current_date
            })
        print(f"   └─ ✅ [AI 10+標籤] {name}: {concepts}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"   └─ ❌ 更新 {name} 失敗: {e}")

def insert_nomura_expert_stocks():
    """優先寫入/更新野村研報的 35 檔重點專家台廠資料"""
    current_date = time.strftime("%Y%m%d")
    print("\n🔥 [第一階段] 優先注入 Nomura 野村研報 35 檔 AI 伺服器專家基因 (10~15 標籤)...")
    
    count = 0
    try:
        with engine.begin() as conn:
            for name, concepts in NOMURA_EXPERT_STOCKS.items():
                conn.execute(text("DELETE FROM dbo.notioninfo WHERE mail1 = :name"), {"name": name})
                
                insert_sql = text(f"""
                    INSERT INTO {TARGET_TABLE} (name1, mail1, word1, 時間戳記)
                    VALUES (:concepts, :name, :word, :ts)
                """)
                conn.execute(insert_sql, {
                    "concepts": concepts, 
                    "name": name, 
                    "word": f"{name}(Nomura野村研報+Expert)", 
                    "ts": current_date
                })
                count += 1
                print(f"   └─ 👑 [Nomura專家] {name}: {concepts}")
        print(f"✅ 完成 {count} 檔 Nomura 專家股 10~15 標籤強效注入！\n")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 注入 Nomura 專家股失敗: {e}\n")

def get_stocks_to_upgrade():
    """找出標籤數少於 8 個且非 Expert 的股票"""
    sql = """
    SELECT DISTINCT RTRIM(M.名稱) as 名稱 
    FROM dbo.MasterStockAnalysis M
    LEFT JOIN dbo.notioninfo N ON RTRIM(M.名稱) = RTRIM(N.mail1)
    WHERE (
          N.word1 IS NULL
          OR (
              N.word1 LIKE '%Ollama%'
              AND (LEN(N.name1) - LEN(REPLACE(N.name1, '|', '')) < 7)
          )
      )
      AND (N.word1 NOT LIKE '%Expert%' OR N.word1 IS NULL)
    """
    try:
        return pd.read_sql(sql, engine)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 讀取資料庫失敗: {e}")
        return pd.DataFrame()

def ask_ollama_v3(names_str):
    """呼叫 Ollama 生成 8 至 12 個高價值極致標籤"""
    prompt = f"""
    你現在是台股產業百科全書與供應鏈專家。請針對名單，給出它們2026年最核心且完整的 8 到 12 個題材標籤。
    
    標籤選取優先權：
    1. 供應鏈客戶（如：谷歌TPU、輝達GPU、超微AMD、亞馬遜AWS、微軟、特斯拉Dojo、戴爾）
    2. 關鍵零組件與角色（如：AI伺服器ODM、高階機殼、BBU、水冷板ColdPlate、CDU、CPO矽光子、ABF載板、CCL、探針卡）
    3. 產業地位與技術（如：半導體代工龍頭、CoWoS先進封測、800G交換器、FOPLP、高階HDI）
    
    格式要求：『名稱:標籤1 | 標籤2 | 標籤3 | 標籤4 | 標籤5 | 標籤6 | 標籤7 | 標籤8 | 標籤9 | 標籤10』
    規範：嚴禁任何解釋文字，每檔股票一行，標籤數量請放寬至 8 到 12 個。
    名單：{names_str}
    """
    
    payload = {"model": MODEL_NAME, "prompt": prompt, "stream": False}
    try:
        response = requests.post(OLLAMA_URL, json=payload, timeout=120)
        return response.json().get('response', '')
    except Exception as e:
        with print_lock:
            print(f"❌ Ollama 連線失敗: {e}")
        return ""

def clean_and_insert(name, concepts):
    """執行先刪後補 (多線程安全版)"""
    current_date = time.strftime("%Y%m%d")
    try:
        # 向連線池索取獨立連線，線程安全
        with engine.begin() as conn:
            conn.execute(text("DELETE FROM dbo.notioninfo WHERE mail1 = :name AND word1 NOT LIKE '%Expert%'"), {"name": name})
            
            insert_sql = text(f"""
                INSERT INTO {TARGET_TABLE} (name1, mail1, word1, 時間戳記)
                VALUES (:concepts, :name, :word, :ts)
            """)
            conn.execute(insert_sql, {
                "concepts": concepts, 
                "name": name, 
                "word": f"{name}(Ollama補全10+)", 
                "ts": current_date
            })
        with print_lock:
            print(f"   └─ ✅ [5線程] {name}: {concepts}")
    except Exception as e:
        with print_lock:
            print(f"   └─ ❌ 更新 {name} 失敗: {e}")

def process_batch(batch_names, total_count):
    """單一線程處理批次任務"""
    global processed_count
    names_str = ", ".join(batch_names)
    
    raw_output = ask_ollama_v3(names_str)
    
    if raw_output:
        for line in raw_output.strip().split('\n'):
            if ":" in line:
                parts = line.split(":", 1)
                if len(parts) == 2:
                    s_name = parts[0].strip()
                    s_concepts = parts[1].strip()
                    if 1 < len(s_name) < 10:
                        clean_and_insert(s_name, s_concepts)

    with print_lock:
        processed_count += len(batch_names)
        print(f"⚡ [進度 {processed_count}/{total_count}] 批次完成: {names_str}")

# ==========================================
# 4. 執行流程 (5 線程並行)
# ==========================================
if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(f"🚀 啟動 Zen AI 產業基因【10~15 標籤 5 線程極速加速計畫】V5.1")
    
    # 步驟 1：優先注入野村研報 Nomura 專家庫 35 檔重點台廠
    insert_nomura_expert_stocks()
    
    # 步驟 2：掃描資料庫中其餘股票，啟用 5 線程並行處理
    print("🤖 [第二階段] 啟用 5 線程並行掃描與補全其餘股票之 10+ 標籤...")
    df_list = get_stocks_to_upgrade()
    total = len(df_list)
    
    if total == 0:
        print("🎉 所有股票已具備完整 8~15 個標籤或為專家手動資料。")
        exit()

    print(f"📊 預計更新/補全總數: {total} 檔 (開啟 5 個工作線程將大幅縮短時間！)")

    batch_size = 4  
    batches = [df_list['名稱'].iloc[i:i+batch_size].tolist() for i in range(0, total, batch_size)]

    # 👑 啟用 5 線程並行執行池 (ThreadPoolExecutor)
    max_threads = 5
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max_threads) as executor:
        futures = [executor.submit(process_batch, batch, total) for batch in batches]
        
        # 等候所有線程完成
        for future in as_completed(futures):
            try:
                future.result()
            except Exception as e:
                with print_lock:
                    print(f"❌ 線程執行發生異常: {e}")

    print("\n🎉 產業基因 10~15 標籤 5 線程極速升級全數完成！")
--- ### ✨ 5 線程優化亮點： 1. `ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=5)`：5 個 Worker 同時向 Ollama 拉取標籤，等候時間直接縮短至 1/5！ 2. SQLAlchemy 線程池 (`pool_size=10`)：配置獨立連線池，確保 5 個線程寫入資料庫時完全獨立、不競爭卡死。 3. `threading.Lock()` 線程安全鎖：確保控制台上的進度條 (`[進度 X/Total]`) 與寫入成功訊息印出時排隊有序、不相互亂碼。 直接執行 `python update_notioninfo.py` 即可體驗飛速升級！

def ask_ollama_v3(names_str):
    """呼叫 Ollama 生成標籤 (V6.0 嚴格實事求是防幻覺版)"""
    prompt = f"""
    你現在是台股產業百科全書與嚴謹的量化專家。請針對名單中的股票，給出真實且精確的題材標籤。
    
    ⚠️ 嚴格防幻覺規範 (違反將導致數據廢棄)：
    1. 實事求是：高科技/AI/半導體公司給予 6~10 個標籤；【傳統產業（如服飾、零售、食品、鋼鐵、建材、化學、紙業）僅給予 2~4 個真實產業標籤】！
    2. 嚴禁亂塞熱門關鍵字：若該公司非 CPO、矽光子、CoWoS、NVIDIA、TPU、800G 交換器供應鏈，【絕對禁止】出現相關標籤！
    
    標籤範例：
    - 淘帝-KY:品牌童裝 | 服飾零售 | 兩岸消費
    - 拓凱:碳纖維複合材料 | 自行車零件 | 航太材料 | 運動器材
    - 上詮:CPO矽光子 | 光纖耦合 | CoWoS光學封裝 | 800G光收發 | 台積電CPO聯盟
    
    格式要求：『名稱:標籤1 | 標籤2 | 標籤3』
    規範：嚴禁任何解釋文字，每檔股票一行。
    名單：{names_str}
    """
    
    payload = {"model": MODEL_NAME, "prompt": prompt, "stream": False}
    try:
        response = requests.post(OLLAMA_URL, json=payload, timeout=120)
        return response.json().get('response', '')
    except Exception as e:
        with print_lock:
            print(f"❌ Ollama 連線失敗: {e}")
        return ""

這是為您升級重構的 `View_AI_Elite_Radar` (AI 戰情雷達檢視表 V2.0)！ 已將 自選股 10 ~ 19（2026 年 10 大核心 AI/CSP 供應鏈） 完整納入追蹤範圍，與原有的 自選股 22 ~ 29 無縫合併！ --- ### 📜 重構 `View_AI_Elite_Radar` 檢視表 T-SQL 腳本 請直接複製以下程式碼，貼在 SSMS 執行（0.1 秒完成）：
sql
USE [stockchangedate];
GO

IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar', 'V') IS NOT NULL
    DROP VIEW dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar;
GO

/* =========================================================================
   🏆 【View_AI_Elite_Radar 檢視表 V2.0 升級版】
   - 擴大追蹤範圍：納入自選股 10 ~ 19 (2026 AI/CSP 10 大核心供應鏈) 
     與原有的自選股 22 ~ 29！
   ========================================================================= */
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[View_AI_Elite_Radar]
AS
SELECT          
    W.來源標籤 AS [分組], 
    T.mail1 AS [策略靈魂], 
    W.代號, 
    W.名稱, 
    W.equityinfo AS [AI診斷筆記], 
    M.專家實戰總分 AS [日線分], 
    M.實戰標籤 AS [日線標籤], 
    S.OSC AS [60M動能(OSC)], 
    S.K AS [60M_K值], 
    /* 自動判定短線氣象邏輯 */ 
    (CASE 
        WHEN S.OSC IS NULL THEN N'⚪ ⏳ 待搬運' 
        WHEN S.OSC > 0 AND S.K > S.D THEN N'🟢 ☀️ 轉強' 
        WHEN S.OSC < 0 AND S.K > S.D THEN N'🟡 ☁️ 止跌' 
        ELSE N'🔴 ⛈️ 修正' 
    END) AS [短線氣象], 
    M.具體概念
FROM [dbo].[View_AllMyWatchlists] W 
INNER JOIN [dbo].[textmsg] T ON RTRIM(W.來源標籤) = RTRIM(T.name1) 
LEFT JOIN [dbo].[MasterStockAnalysis] M ON RTRIM(W.代號) = RTRIM(M.代號) AND M.日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM [dbo].[MasterStockAnalysis]) 
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC, 時間 DESC) AS rn
    FROM [stockchange].[dbo].[Stock60M]
) S ON RTRIM(W.代號) = RTRIM(S.代號) AND S.rn = 1
/* 擴大追蹤範圍：涵蓋自選股 10~19 (2026 AI/CSP 供應鏈) 與 22~29 */ 
WHERE W.來源標籤 LIKE N'自選股1%' 
   OR W.來源標籤 IN (N'自選股22', N'自選股23', N'自選股24', N'自選股25', N'自選股26', N'自選股27', N'自選股28', N'自選股29');
GO

            // 👑【Magic Click】：點擊全看板任何表格中的股票列，一秒自動跳轉至「四大聯動圖表」並自動繪圖！
            $(document).on('click', 'table tbody tr', function (e) {
                if ($(e.target).is('button, a, input, select, th') || $(this).parents('thead').length > 0) return;

                let stockCode = "";
                $(this).find('td').each(function() {
                    const txt = $(this).text().trim();
                    if (txt.match(/^\d{4}$/)) {
                        stockCode = txt;
                        return false; 
                    }
                });

                if (stockCode) {
                    console.log("🎯 點擊股票代號: " + stockCode + " ➔ 切換四大圖表中心...");

                    const chartTabBtn = document.getElementById('charts-tab');
                    if (chartTabBtn) {
                        var tabInst = new bootstrap.Tab(chartTabBtn);
                        tabInst.show();
                    } else {
                        $('#charts-tab').tab('show');
                    }

                    let attempts = 0;
                    const checkIframeAndRun = setInterval(function() {
                        attempts++;
                        const iframe = document.getElementById('iframe-charts');
                        
                        if (iframe && iframe.contentWindow && iframe.contentWindow.document) {
                            const stockInput = iframe.contentWindow.document.getElementById('keyword');
                            const btnPost = iframe.contentWindow.document.getElementById('btn_query_post');

                            if (stockInput && btnPost) {
                                clearInterval(checkIframeAndRun);
                                stockInput.value = stockCode;
                                btnPost.click();
                                try { iframe.contentWindow.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' }); } catch(err) {}
                            }
                        }

                        if (attempts >= 10) clearInterval(checkIframeAndRun);
                    }, 300);
                }
            });
        });

        // 🎯 頁籤 1 數據：0ms 多維共振極速掃描
        function searchMultiResonance() {
            const hitCount = $("#selHitCount").val() || 3;
            const momentumMode = $("#selMomentumMode").val() || 2;

            const sql = `SELECT TOP 100
                [代號], [名稱], [盤中成交價] AS [現價], [盤中漲幅] AS [漲幅%], [盤中總量] AS [總量],
                [HitCount] AS [共振維度數], [ResonanceTag] AS [共振等級],
                [DimA_Status] AS [雙動能狀態], [DimB_Status] AS [OBV星號狀態], [DimC_Status] AS [價格星號狀態], [DimD_Status] AS [彩虹金叉狀態]
            FROM stockchangedate.dbo.ResonanceMultiFactor_Snapshot
            WHERE [HitCount] >= ${hitCount}
              AND (${momentumMode} = 0 OR [DimA_DualMomentum] = ${momentumMode})
            ORDER BY [HitCount] DESC, [DimD_RainbowScore] DESC, [盤中總量] DESC;`;

            execQueryToTable(sql, "stockchangedate", "#tblMultiResonance");
        }

        // 👑【頁籤 2 數據】：60M 伏兵轉強雷達 (專抓 🟢 ☀️ 轉強)
        function loadTurningStrong() {
            // A. 自選股 29 (波段伏兵已轉強發動榜)
            const sql29Strong = `SELECT TOP 50
                代號, 名稱, ROUND([60M動能(OSC)], 2) AS [60M_OSC], ROUND([60M_K值], 1) AS [60M_K], 日線分, 短線氣象, AI診斷筆記
            FROM stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar
            WHERE 分組 = N'自選股29' AND [短線氣象] LIKE N'%轉強%'
            ORDER BY [60M動能(OSC)] DESC;`;

            execQueryToTable(sql29Strong, "stockchangedate", "#tblTurningStrong29");

            // B. 全市場 60M 短線氣象轉強精銳榜
            const sqlAllStrong = `SELECT TOP 50
                代號, 名稱, 分組, ROUND([60M動能(OSC)], 2) AS [60M_OSC], ROUND([60M_K值], 1) AS [60M_K], 日線分, 短線氣象, 具體概念
            FROM stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar
            WHERE [短線氣象] LIKE N'%轉強%'
            ORDER BY [60M動能(OSC)] DESC, [日線分] DESC;`;

            execQueryToTable(sqlAllStrong, "stockchangedate", "#tblTurningStrongAll");
        }

        // 🔄 手動刷新快照程序
        function refreshResonanceSnapshot() {
            if (typeof Swal !== 'undefined') {
                Swal.fire({ title: '⏳ 正在重構全市場多維共振快照...', text: '約需 1 秒，請稍候', allowOutsideClick: false, didOpen: () => { Swal.showLoading(); } });
            }
            
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST",
                url: API_SQL_URL,
                data: JSON.stringify({ sql: "EXEC stockchangedate.dbo.sp_RefreshMultiResonanceSnapshot;", db: "stockchangedate", pwd: "2157" }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                dataType: "json",
                success: function () {
                    if (typeof Swal !== 'undefined') Swal.fire('成功', '全市場多維共振快照已重構完成！', 'success');
                    searchMultiResonance();
                }
            });
        }

        // 🌐 頁籤 3 數據：盤中雷達 ✕ 自選股 28/29
        function loadIntradayRadar() {
            const sqlRadar = `SELECT TOP 30
                C.[代號], C.[股票] AS [名稱], C.[盤中成交價] AS [現價], C.[漲幅_百分比] AS [漲幅%], C.[盤中總量] AS [總量],
                ROUND(C.[預估今日總分], 2) AS [預估總分], C.[細產業名稱] AS [產業]
            FROM stockchangedate.dbo.IntradayScoreCache C
            WHERE C.[盤中總量] >= 500
            ORDER BY C.[預估今日總分] DESC;`;

            execQueryToTable(sqlRadar, "stockchangedate", "#tblIntradayRadar");

            const sql2829 = `SELECT TOP 30
                代號, 名稱, 分組, ROUND([60M動能(OSC)], 2) AS [60M_OSC], 短線氣象
            FROM stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar
            WHERE 分組 IN (N'自選股28', N'自選股29')
            ORDER BY 分組 DESC, [60M動能(OSC)] DESC;`;

            execQueryToTable(sql2829, "stockchangedate", "#tblWatchlist2829");
        }

        // 💎 頁籤 5 數據：3-Way 離場勝率快照 ✕ FactSet 法人目標價
        function loadDNAndFundamentals() {
            const sql3Exits = `SELECT TOP 50
                [代號], [名稱], [完成交易次數], 
                [Return_5MA] AS [5MA期望值%], [Return_10MA] AS [10MA期望值%], [Return_20MA] AS [20MA期望值%], 
                [OptimalExit] AS [最適建議]
            FROM stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality_3Exits
            ORDER BY [Return_20MA] DESC;`;

            execQueryToTable(sql3Exits, "stockchangedate", "#tbl3Exits");

            const sqlGems = `SELECT TOP 50
                RTRIM(F.代號) AS [代號],
                ISNULL(M.名稱, F.代號) AS [名稱],
                ISNULL(M.盤中現價, 0) AS [現價],
                ISNULL(R.最新公告營收年增, 0) AS [營收年增%],
                ISNULL(FN.EPS累計, 0) AS [半年報EPS],
                F.預估目標價 AS [FactSet目標價],
                ROUND(((F.預估目標價 - ISNULL(M.盤中現價, F.舊EPS中位數)) / NULLIF(ISNULL(M.盤中現價, F.舊EPS中位數), 0)) * 100, 1) AS [潛在空間%]
            FROM stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates F
            LEFT JOIN (
                SELECT 代號, 名稱, 盤中現價, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
                FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis
                WHERE 盤中現價 > 0
            ) M ON RTRIM(F.代號) = RTRIM(M.代號) AND M.rn = 1
            LEFT JOIN (
                SELECT 代號, 最新公告營收年增, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 交易日期 DESC) AS rn
                FROM stockchangedate.dbo.View_Realtime_Revenue
            ) R ON RTRIM(F.代號) = RTRIM(R.代號) AND R.rn = 1
            LEFT JOIN (
                SELECT 代號, EPS累計, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
                FROM stockchangedate.dbo.financesum
            ) FN ON RTRIM(F.代號) = RTRIM(FN.代號) AND FN.rn = 1
            WHERE F.預估目標價 > 0
            ORDER BY ROUND(((F.預估目標價 - ISNULL(M.盤中現價, F.舊EPS中位數)) / NULLIF(ISNULL(M.盤中現價, F.舊EPS中位數), 0)) * 100, 1) DESC;`;

            execQueryToTable(sqlGems, "stockchangedate", "#tblFundamentalGems");
        }

        // 📅 頁籤 6 數據：全球重大總經日曆
        function loadMacroCalendar() {
            const sqlMacro = `SELECT TOP 50
                [公布日期], [公布時間] AS [時間], [國家區域], [指標類別], [指標名稱], [重要性], [前值], [預測值], ISNULL([實際值], N'⏳ 待公布') AS [實際值], [影響解讀]
            FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MacroEconomicCalendar
            WHERE [公布日期] >= 20260101
            ORDER BY [公布日期] ASC, [公布時間] ASC;`;

            execQueryToTable(sqlMacro, "stockchangedate", "#tblMacroCalendar");
        }

        // 🛠️ 通用數據連線與 DataTables 安全引擎
        function execQueryToTable(sql, db, tableSelector) {
            console.log("📡 正在執行 AJAX 查詢 [" + tableSelector + "]...");
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST",
                url: API_SQL_URL,
                data: JSON.stringify({ sql: sql, db: db, pwd: "2157" }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                dataType: "json",
                timeout: 300000,
                success: function (res) {
                    try {
                        let dataStr = res.d;
                        if (!dataStr) return;

                        if (dataStr.startsWith("錯誤：")) {
                            $(tableSelector).html(`<tbody><tr><td class="text-danger p-3">❌ SQL 錯誤: ${dataStr}</td></tr></tbody>`);
                            return;
                        }

                        const cleanedJson = dataStr.replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F-\u009F]/g, function(ch) {
                            if (ch === '\n') return '\\n';
                            if (ch === '\r') return '\\r';
                            if (ch === '\t') return '\\t';
                            return '';
                        });

                        const data = JSON.parse(cleanedJson);
                        if (!data || data.length === 0) {
                            $(tableSelector).html(`<tbody><tr><td class="text-warning p-3">✅ 暫無符合條件數據。</td></tr></tbody>`);
                            return;
                        }

                        renderDataTable(data, tableSelector);
                    } catch (e) {
                        $(tableSelector).html(`<tbody><tr><td class="text-danger p-3">❌ JSON 解析失敗: ${e.message}</td></tr></tbody>`);
                    }
                },
                error: function () {
                    $(tableSelector).html(`<tbody><tr><td class="text-danger p-3">❌ 連線 DataService2.aspx 失敗！</td></tr></tbody>`);
                }
            });
        }

        function renderDataTable(data, tableSelector) {
            if (!data || data.length === 0) return;

            if ($.fn.DataTable.isDataTable(tableSelector)) {
                $(tableSelector).DataTable().clear().destroy();
            }

            $(tableSelector).empty();

            let keys = Object.keys(data[0]);
            let thead = "<thead><tr>" + keys.map(k => `<th>${k}</th>`).join('') + "</tr></thead>";
            let tbody = "<tbody>";
            data.forEach(row => {
                tbody += "<tr>";
                keys.forEach(k => { 
                    let val = (row[k] !== null && row[k] !== undefined) ? row[k] : '';
                    tbody += `<td>${val}</td>`; 
                });
                tbody += "</tr>";
            });
            tbody += "</tbody>";

            $(tableSelector).html(thead + tbody);

            $(tableSelector).DataTable({
                "language": { "url": "//cdn.datatables.net/plug-ins/1.13.6/i18n/zh-HANT.json" },
                "pageLength": 10,
                "order": [],
                "scrollCollapse": true,
                "destroy": true
            });
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

    // 🎯 0ms 多維共振極速掃描
    function searchMultiResonance() {
        const hitCount = $("#selHitCount").val() || 3;
        const momentumMode = $("#selMomentumMode").val() || 2;

        const sql = `SELECT TOP 100
            [代號], [名稱], [盤中成交價] AS [現價], [盤中漲幅] AS [漲幅%], [盤中總量] AS [總量],
            [HitCount] AS [共振維度數], [ResonanceTag] AS [共振等級],
            [DimA_Status] AS [雙動能狀態], [DimB_Status] AS [OBV星號狀態], [DimC_Status] AS [價格星號狀態], [DimD_Status] AS [彩虹金叉狀態]
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.ResonanceMultiFactor_Snapshot
        WHERE [HitCount] >= ${hitCount}
          AND (${momentumMode} = 0 OR [DimA_DualMomentum] = ${momentumMode})
        ORDER BY [HitCount] DESC, [DimD_RainbowScore] DESC, [盤中總量] DESC;`;

        execQueryToTable(sql, "stockchangedate", "#tblMultiResonance");
    }

    // ☀️ 60M 伏兵轉強雷達
    function loadTurningStrong() {

        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar
        WHERE 分組 = N'自選股29' AND [短線氣象] LIKE N'%轉強%'
        ORDER BY [60M動能(OSC)] DESC;`;

        execQueryToTable(sql29Strong, "stockchangedate", "#tblTurningStrong29");

        const sqlAllStrong = `SELECT TOP 50
            代號, 名稱, 分組, ROUND([60M動能(OSC)], 2) AS [60M_OSC], ROUND([60M_K值], 1) AS [60M_K], 日線分, 短線氣象, 具體概念
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar
        WHERE [短線氣象] LIKE N'%轉強%'
        ORDER BY [60M動能(OSC)] DESC, [日線分] DESC;`;

        execQueryToTable(sqlAllStrong, "stockchangedate", "#tblTurningStrongAll");

    // 🌐 頁籤 2 數據 (套用長官優化後的 RIGHT OUTER JOIN 全表查詢)
    function loadIntradayRadar() {
        const sqlRadar = `SELECT M.代號, M.名稱, C.盤中成交價 AS 現價, C.漲幅_百分比 AS [漲幅%], C.盤中總量 AS 總量, ROUND(C.預估今日總分, 2) AS 盤中預估總分, ROUND(M.專家實戰總分,2) AS 舊實戰總分, C.新搬運_60分K, C.細產業名稱 AS 產業, C.股本億
FROM IntradayScoreCache AS C 
RIGHT OUTER JOIN MasterStockAnalysis AS M ON C.代號 = M.代號
WHERE (M.日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) AS mydate FROM MasterStockAnalysis AS MasterStockAnalysis_1))
ORDER BY C.預估今日總分 DESC;`;

        execQueryToTable(sqlRadar, "stockchangedate", "#tblIntradayRadar");

        const sql2829 = `SELECT TOP 200
            代號, 名稱, 分組, ROUND([60M動能(OSC)], 2) AS [60M_OSC], 短線氣象
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar
        WHERE 分組 IN (N'自選股28', N'自選股29')
        ORDER BY 分組 DESC, [60M動能(OSC)] DESC;`;

        execQueryToTable(sql2829, "stockchangedate", "#tblWatchlist2829");
    }

    // 💎 頁籤 4 數據 (套用長官優化後的全表 3-Way 勝率對照)
    function loadDNAndFundamentals() {
        const sql3Exits = `SELECT 
            [代號], [名稱], [完成交易次數],
            [Return_5MA] AS [5MA期望值%], [Return_10MA] AS [10MA期望值%], [Return_20MA] AS [20MA期望值%],
            [OptimalExit] AS [最適建議]
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality_3Exits
        ORDER BY [Return_20MA] DESC;`;

        execQueryToTable(sql3Exits, "stockchangedate", "#tbl3Exits");

        const sqlGems = `SELECT TOP 50
            RTRIM(F.代號) AS [代號],
            ISNULL(M.名稱, F.代號) AS [名稱],
            ISNULL(M.盤中現價, 0) AS [現價],
            ISNULL(R.最新公告營收年增, 0) AS [營收年增%],
            ISNULL(FN.EPS累計, 0) AS [半年報EPS],
            F.預估目標價 AS [FactSet目標價],
            ROUND(((F.預估目標價 - ISNULL(M.盤中現價, F.舊EPS中位數)) / NULLIF(ISNULL(M.盤中現價, F.舊EPS中位數), 0)) * 100, 1) AS [潛在空間%]
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates F
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT 代號, 名稱, 盤中現價, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
            FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis
            WHERE 盤中現價 > 0
        ) M ON RTRIM(F.代號) = RTRIM(M.代號) AND M.rn = 1
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT 代號, 最新公告營收年增, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 交易日期 DESC) AS rn
            FROM stockchangedate.dbo.View_Realtime_Revenue
        ) R ON RTRIM(F.代號) = RTRIM(R.代號) AND R.rn = 1
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT 代號, EPS累計, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
            FROM stockchangedate.dbo.financesum
        ) FN ON RTRIM(F.代號) = RTRIM(FN.代號) AND FN.rn = 1
        WHERE F.預估目標價 > 0
        ORDER BY ROUND(((F.預估目標價 - ISNULL(M.盤中現價, F.舊EPS中位數)) / NULLIF(ISNULL(M.盤中現價, F.舊EPS中位數), 0)) * 100, 1) DESC;`;

        execQueryToTable(sqlGems, "stockchangedate", "#tblFundamentalGems");
    }

    // 📅 頁籤 5 數據：全球總經日曆
    function loadMacroCalendar() {
        const sqlMacro = `SELECT TOP 50
            [公布日期], [公布時間] AS [時間], [國家區域], [指標類別], [指標名稱], [重要性], [前值], [預測值], ISNULL([實際值], N'⏳ 待公布') AS [實際值], [影響解讀]
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MacroEconomicCalendar
        WHERE [公布日期] >= 20260101
        ORDER BY [公布日期] ASC, [公布時間] ASC;`;

        execQueryToTable(sqlMacro, "stockchangedate", "#tblMacroCalendar");
    }

    // 通用 AJAX 數據連線
    function execQueryToTable(sql, db, tableSelector) {
        console.log("📡 正在執行 AJAX 查詢 [" + tableSelector + "]...");
        $.ajax({
            type: "POST",
            url: API_SQL_URL,
            data: JSON.stringify({ sql: sql, db: db, pwd: "2157" }),
            contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
            dataType: "json",
            timeout: 300000,
            success: function (res) {
                try {
                    let dataStr = res.d;
                    if (!dataStr) return;

                    if (dataStr.startsWith("錯誤：")) {
                        $(tableSelector).html(`<tbody><tr><td class="text-danger p-3">❌ SQL 錯誤: ${dataStr}</td></tr></tbody>`);
                        return;
                    }

                    const cleanedJson = dataStr.replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F-\u009F]/g, function(ch) {
                        if (ch === '\n') return '\\n';
                        if (ch === '\r') return '\\r';
                        if (ch === '\t') return '\\t';
                        return '';
                    });

                    const data = JSON.parse(cleanedJson);
                    if (!data || data.length === 0) {
                        $(tableSelector).html(`<tbody><tr><td class="text-warning p-3">✅ 暫無符合條件數據。</td></tr></tbody>`);
                        return;
                    }

                    renderDataTable(data, tableSelector);
                } catch (e) {
                    $(tableSelector).html(`<tbody><tr><td class="text-danger p-3">❌ JSON 解析失敗: ${e.message}</td></tr></tbody>`);
                }
            },
            error: function () {
                $(tableSelector).html(`<tbody><tr><td class="text-danger p-3">❌ 連線 DataService2.aspx 失敗！</td></tr></tbody>`);
            }
        });
    }

    function renderDataTable(data, tableSelector) {
        if (!data || data.length === 0) return;

        if ($.fn.DataTable.isDataTable(tableSelector)) {
            $(tableSelector).DataTable().clear().destroy();
        }

        $(tableSelector).empty();

        let keys = Object.keys(data[0]);
        let thead = "<thead><tr>" + keys.map(k => `<th>${k}</th>`).join('') + "</tr></thead>";
        let tbody = "<tbody>";
        data.forEach(row => {
            tbody += "<tr>";
            keys.forEach(k => { 
                let val = (row[k] !== null && row[k] !== undefined) ? row[k] : '';
                tbody += `<td>${val}</td>`; 
            });
            tbody += "</tr>";
        });
        tbody += "</tbody>";

        $(tableSelector).html(thead + tbody);

        $(tableSelector).DataTable({
            "language": { "url": "//cdn.datatables.net/plug-ins/1.13.6/i18n/zh-HANT.json" },
            "pageLength": 10,
            "order": [],
            "scrollCollapse": true,
            "destroy": true
        });
    }
</script>

python
import os
import time
import pandas as pd
import pyodbc
import numpy as np
from watchdog.observers import Observer
from watchdog.events import FileSystemEventHandler

# ==========================================
# 【1. 設定區】
# ==========================================
WATCH_FOLDER = r"C:\StockExport"
SERVER = "pc048000110"
DATABASE = "stockchange"
DRIVER = "{SQL Server}"
TARGET_TABLE = "basicinfo"

FINAL_COLUMNS = [
    'K線', '代號', '名稱', '買進', '賣出', '成交價', '漲跌', '漲幅', 'K棒', '單量', 
    '總量', '最高', '最低', '開盤價', '產業分類', '交易所分類', '上市1上櫃2', '上市櫃年數', '股本億', '市值億'
]

NUMERIC_COLS = ['買進', '賣出', '成交價', '漲跌', '漲幅', '單量', '總量', '最高', '最低', '開盤價', '股本億', '市值億', '上市1上櫃2', '上市櫃年數']

class ExcelHandler(FileSystemEventHandler):
    def on_modified(self, event):
        if not event.is_directory and event.src_path.endswith('.xlsx'):
            self.process_file(event.src_path)

    def on_created(self, event):
        if not event.is_directory and event.src_path.endswith('.xlsx'):
            self.process_file(event.src_path)

    def process_file(self, file_path):
        filename = os.path.basename(file_path)
        if filename.startswith('~$'): return

        print(f"\n🕒 [{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] 偵測到數據更新: {filename}")
        
        df = None
        # 15 次重試，每次 1.5 秒，總共給 20 多秒處理理財寶的存檔延遲
        for i in range(15):
            try:
                # 嘗試靜默讀取
                df = pd.read_excel(file_path, engine='openpyxl')
                if df is not None: break
            except Exception:
                if i == 0:
                    print(f"⏳ 檔案準備中，請稍候...", end="", flush=True)
                else:
                    print(".", end="", flush=True)
                time.sleep(1.5)

        if df is None:
            print("\n❌ 讀取超時：檔案可能正被 Excel 開啟或理財寶尚未釋放。")
            return

        print(f"\n📖 [成功] 取得數據 (共 {len(df)} 筆)。開始寫入資料庫...")

        try:
            # 數據清洗
            df.columns = [str(c).replace(' ', '').replace('\n', '').strip() for c in df.columns]
            mapping = {'漲幅%': '漲幅', '開盤': '開盤價', '1上市2上櫃': '上市1上櫃2', '股本(億)': '股本億', '市值(億)': '市值億', '代碼': '代號'}
            df.rename(columns=mapping, inplace=True)

            for col in FINAL_COLUMNS:
                if col not in df.columns: df[col] = None
            
            df = df.replace('--', np.nan)
            for col in NUMERIC_COLS:
                df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')
            
            final_df = df[FINAL_COLUMNS].astype(object)
            final_df = final_df.where(pd.notnull(final_df), None)
            data_to_insert = final_df.values.tolist()

            conn_str = f'DRIVER={DRIVER};SERVER={SERVER};DATABASE={DATABASE};Trusted_Connection=yes'
            with pyodbc.connect(conn_str) as conn:
                cursor = conn.cursor()
                cursor.fast_executemany = False 
                cursor.execute(f"TRUNCATE TABLE {TARGET_TABLE}")
                placeholders = ",".join(["?"] * 20)
                sql = f"INSERT INTO {TARGET_TABLE} ({','.join(FINAL_COLUMNS)}) VALUES ({placeholders})"
                cursor.executemany(sql, data_to_insert)
                
                # 👑【核心加強】：更新 basicinfo 後，自動觸發盤中估分快取刷新！
                try:
                    cursor.execute("EXEC stockchangedate.dbo.sp_RefreshIntradayScoreCache")
                except Exception as sp_err:
                    print(f"⚠️ 盤中快取刷新提醒: {sp_err}")

                conn.commit()
            print(f"✅ 【完成】SQL Server 即時價量 [basicinfo] 與盤中快取已同步更新！")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"\n❌ 寫入 SQL 失敗: {e}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("-" * 50)
    print(f"🚀 Zen AI 盤中即時同步工具啟動 (監控: {WATCH_FOLDER})")
    print("-" * 50)
    event_handler = ExcelHandler()
    observer = Observer()
    observer.schedule(event_handler, WATCH_FOLDER, recursive=False)
    observer.start()
    try:
        while True: time.sleep(1)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        observer.stop()
    observer.join()

太精彩了長官！這段 AutoHotkey (AHK) 腳本正是我們整套盤中自動化搬運的「靈魂發動機 (RPA Trigger)」！ 🤖⚡ 您剛才貼出的這段 AHK 腳本非常厲害，它直接模擬右鍵選單 `Send, {Down 7}` 導出 Excel，並精確處理了 Windows 另存新檔視窗與覆蓋確認，最後把 `EXCEL.EXE` 強制關閉以釋放檔案鎖定給 Python 讀取。 不過從您貼出的 AHK 程式碼來看，目前只有 `F9::`（手動按下 F9）的觸發機制，還缺少「電腦閒置 5 分鐘全自動背景發動」的計時器 (`SetTimer`)！ --- ### 🛠️ 為您升級【閒置 5 分鐘全自動倒檔 ✕ 盤中時段鎖定 AHK 腳本】 我為您加入 `A_TimeIdlePhysical >= 300000` (電腦閒置滿 5 分鐘) ＋ `08:55 ~ 13:35` (台股盤中交易時段鎖定) 機制： * 完全不打擾操作：當您在電腦前打字或用滑鼠時，它絕對不會發動（避免干擾您工作）。 * 閒置自動發動：只要您離開電腦或閒置滿 5 分鐘，且處於台股盤中時段，它就會自動靜默執行一次倒檔！ * 手動備援：您隨時按下 `F9`，依然可以立刻手動觸發倒檔！ --- ### 📜 `AutoExport_FixedPath.ahk` (升級全自動 5 分鐘計時器版) 請直接複製以下程式碼，覆蓋覆寫您的 `AutoExport_FixedPath.ahk` 檔案：

; =========================================================================
; 🤖 Zen AI 盤中自動化 RPA 倒檔腳本 V2.0
; 1. 支援 F9 手動一鍵觸發
; 2. 支援「電腦閒置 5 分鐘」+「台股盤中 08:55~13:35」全自動背景倒檔 (不打擾操作)
; =========================================================================

; 💡 每 1 分鐘檢查一次是否符合「閒置 5 分鐘 + 盤中時段」條件
SetTimer, AutoExportTimer, 60000 
return

; -------------------------------------------------------------------------
; 🕒 全自動閒置判定定時器 (Auto-Export Timer)
; -------------------------------------------------------------------------
AutoExportTimer:
    ; A. 取得當前時間 (HHmm 格式，例如 0930)
    FormatTime, CurrentTime,, HHmm
    FormatTime, CurrentWDay,, WDay ; 1=週日, 2=週一 ... 6=週五, 7=週六

    ; B. 判斷是否為「台股交易日 (週一至週五)」且處於「盤中時段 (08:55 ~ 13:35)」
    isTradingHours := (CurrentWDay >= 2 and CurrentWDay <= 6 and CurrentTime >= 0855 and CurrentTime <= 1335)

    ; C. 判斷使用者物理鍵盤/滑鼠閒置時間 (A_TimeIdlePhysical) 是否超過 5 分鐘 (300,000 毫秒)
    isIdle5Min := (A_TimeIdlePhysical >= 300000)

    ; 符合條件 ➔ 自動觸發倒檔！
    if (isTradingHours and isIdle5Min)
    {
        ToolTip, 🤖 偵測到電腦閒置滿 5 分鐘，啟動盤中全自動倒檔...
        Sleep, 1000
        ToolTip
        gosub, PerformExport
    }
return

; -------------------------------------------------------------------------

; -------------------------------------------------------------------------
F9::

return

; -------------------------------------------------------------------------

; -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    SoundBeep, 750, 200

    Process, Close, EXCEL.EXE
    Sleep, 500
    
    TargetFile := "C:\StockExport\basicinfo基本資訊自選監控.xlsx" 

    if (WinExist("ahk_exe CMoney_Utility.exe") or WinExist("理財寶"))
    {
        WinActivate 
        Sleep, 300
        MouseGetPos, currentX, currentY
        Click, Right, %currentX%, %currentY%
        Sleep, 1000 

        Send, {Down 7}
        Sleep, 300
        Send, {Enter}

        ; 等待另存新檔視窗
        WinWait, ahk_class #32770, , 10
        if ErrorLevel {

            return
        }
        
        WinActivate, ahk_class #32770

        ControlFocus, Edit1, ahk_class #32770
        Send, ^a{Delete}
        Sleep, 300

        ClipWait, 2
        Send, ^v 
        Sleep, 500
        Send, {Enter}
        
        ; 處理取代舊檔
        Sleep, 1000
        if (WinExist("確認另存新檔") or WinExist("ahk_class #32770", "取代")) {
            WinActivate
            Send, {Left}{Enter}
        }

        ; 等待新開啟的 Excel 並關閉它，釋放給 Python 讀取
        ToolTip, ⏳ 等待 Excel 彈出後關閉...
        WinWait, ahk_exe EXCEL.EXE, , 10
        if !ErrorLevel {
            Sleep, 2000 ; 給 Excel 一點緩衝
            Process, Close, EXCEL.EXE 
            ToolTip, ✅ 檔案已釋放，Python 監聽器處理中...
        }
        
        MouseMove, %currentX%, %currentY%, 2
        Sleep, 2000
        ToolTip
    }

autohotkey
#Persistent
#NoEnv
SetTitleMatchMode, 2
CoordMode, Mouse, Screen

; =========================================================================
; 🤖 Zen AI 盤中自動化 RPA 倒檔腳本 V3.0
; 1. 每 5 分鐘固定檢查 (08:55~13:35 台股盤中)
; 2. 每次執行前先【嗶、嗶、嗶】連續 3 聲發出警報
; 3. 右下角彈出 Windows 通知與【第 X 次倒檔】時間計數器
; =========================================================================

Global ExportCount := 0  ; 倒檔次數計數器

; 💡 每 5 分鐘 (300,000 毫秒) 固定發動一次
SetTimer, AutoExportTimer, 300000 
return

; -------------------------------------------------------------------------
; 🕒 每 5 分鐘自動檢查與倒檔程序
; -------------------------------------------------------------------------
AutoExportTimer:
    FormatTime, CurrentTime,, HHmm
    FormatTime, CurrentWDay,, WDay ; 1=週日, 2=週一 ... 6=週五, 7=週六

    ; A. 判斷是否為台股交易日 (週一至週五 08:55 ~ 13:35)
    isTradingHours := (CurrentWDay >= 2 and CurrentWDay <= 6 and CurrentTime >= 0855 and CurrentTime <= 1335)

    ; B. 閒置門檻放寬為 20 秒 (20,000 毫秒沒碰鍵盤滑鼠即發動)
    isIdleSoft := (A_TimeIdlePhysical >= 20000)

    if (isTradingHours and isIdleSoft)
    {
        gosub, PerformExport
    }
return

; -------------------------------------------------------------------------
; ⌨️ F9 手動一鍵觸發熱鍵
; -------------------------------------------------------------------------
F9::
    gosub, PerformExport
return

; -------------------------------------------------------------------------
; 🚀 核心倒檔程序 (含嗶 3 聲與通知)
; -------------------------------------------------------------------------
PerformExport:
    ExportCount++
    FormatTime, NowTimeStr,, HH:mm:ss

    ; 🔊 1. 執行前【嗶、嗶、嗶】連續 3 聲高音提示！
    SoundBeep, 900, 150
    Sleep, 100
    SoundBeep, 900, 150
    Sleep, 100
    SoundBeep, 900, 150
    Sleep, 300

    ; 📊 2. 螢幕右下角彈出 Windows 系統通知
    TrayTip, 🤖 Zen AI 盤中倒檔, 【第 %ExportCount% 次】自動倒檔發動中！(%NowTimeStr%), 5, 1
    ToolTip, 🧹 【第 %ExportCount% 次倒檔】正在清理環境並準備存檔 (%NowTimeStr%)...
    
    Process, Close, EXCEL.EXE
    Sleep, 500
    
    TargetFile := "C:\StockExport\basicinfo基本資訊自選監控.xlsx" 

    if (WinExist("ahk_exe CMoney_Utility.exe") or WinExist("理財寶"))
    {
        WinActivate 
        Sleep, 300
        MouseGetPos, currentX, currentY
        Click, Right, %currentX%, %currentY%
        Sleep, 1000 

        Send, {Down 7}
        Sleep, 300
        Send, {Enter}

        ; 等待另存新檔視窗
        WinWait, ahk_class #32770, , 10
        if ErrorLevel {
            ToolTip, ❌ 沒看到存檔視窗
            return
        }
        
        WinActivate, ahk_class #32770
        Sleep, 500
        ControlFocus, Edit1, ahk_class #32770
        Send, ^a{Delete}
        Sleep, 300
        
        Clipboard := TargetFile
        ClipWait, 2
        Send, ^v 
        Sleep, 500
        Send, {Enter}
        
        ; 處理取代舊檔
        Sleep, 1000
        if (WinExist("確認另存新檔") or WinExist("ahk_class #32770", "取代")) {
            WinActivate
            Send, {Left}{Enter}
        }

        ; 等待新開啟的 Excel 並關閉它，釋放給 Python 讀取
        ToolTip, ⏳ 等待 Excel 彈出後關閉...
        WinWait, ahk_exe EXCEL.EXE, , 10
        if !ErrorLevel {
            Sleep, 2000 ; 給 Excel 一點緩衝
            Process, Close, EXCEL.EXE 
            
            ; 🔊 倒檔完成再嗶 1 長聲
            SoundBeep, 1200, 300
            ToolTip, ✅ 【第 %ExportCount% 次】倒檔完成，已釋放給 Python 處理中！
        }
        
        MouseMove, %currentX%, %currentY%, 2
        Sleep, 2500
        ToolTip
    }
return

sql
USE [stockchangedate];
GO

IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.sp_RunWarRoomDailyRefresh', 'P') IS NOT NULL
    DROP PROCEDURE dbo.sp_RunWarRoomDailyRefresh;
GO

/* =========================================================================
   🏆 【Zen AI 戰情室大一統一鍵刷新主控程序】
   - 解決預存程序繁多問題，按正確相依順序 1 秒自動串聯執行全套快照刷新！
   ========================================================================= */
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_RunWarRoomDailyRefresh
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    PRINT '🚀 [1/5] 正在執行全市場即時均線運算 (sp_CalcIntradayStockLive_all)...';
    EXEC dbo.sp_CalcIntradayStockLive_all;

    PRINT '🚀 [2/5] 正在刷新盤中估分快取表 (sp_RefreshIntradayScoreCache)...';
    EXEC dbo.sp_RefreshIntradayScoreCache;

    PRINT '🚀 [3/5] 正在刷新全市場多維共振快照 (sp_RefreshMultiResonanceSnapshot)...';
    EXEC dbo.sp_RefreshMultiResonanceSnapshot;

    PRINT '🚀 [4/5] 正在刷新 3-Way 離場勝率快照 (sp_Refresh_StockPersonality_3Exits)...';
    EXEC dbo.sp_Refresh_StockPersonality_3Exits;

    PRINT '🚀 [5/5] 正在刷新 AllCross_Snapshot 與 AI 自選股快照...';
    EXEC stockchange.dbo.sp_UpdateAllCrossSnapshot;
    EXEC dbo.sp_RefreshAIWatchlist;

    PRINT '🎉 【大功告成】全戰情室所有快照表已 100% 按正確順序更新完畢！';
END
GO

長官觀察得非常入微！這是一個非常重要的「盤中日期對齊」細節！ 🔍🕵️‍♂️ --- ### 🚨 為什麼剛才 `更新時間` 是今日 2026/08/24，但 `日期` 卻顯示 20260821？ #### 原因： 1. 今天是 `2026/08/24` (週一盤中 12:31)。 2. 預存程序讀取的歷史表 `MasterStockAnalysis` 與 `ScoreCrossHistory` 是盤後結算表，其最新的完整收盤歷史日期是 `20260821` (上週五)。 3. 舊版語法直接把歷史表的 `T1.日期` (20260821) 拿來當作快照表的 `[日期]` 欄位寫入，所以在週一盤中刷新快照時，才會出現 `更新時間: 2026-08-24 12:31` 但 `日期: 20260821` 的現象！ --- ### 🛠️ 1 秒修復：將快照表 `[日期]` 強制對齊今日計算日期 (`20260824`) 我們將預存程序寫入快照表時的 `[日期]` 欄位，改為直接帶入 `@TodayINT` (即今日日期 20260824)，這樣不論是在盤中還是盤後刷新，`[日期]` 與 `[更新時間]` 就會 100% 精確對齊當天！ 請在 SSMS 執行以下修復後的 T-SQL：
sql
USE [stockchangedate];
GO

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.sp_RefreshMultiResonanceSnapshot
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    PRINT '🚀 開始進行全市場 [ResonanceMultiFactor_Snapshot] 多維共振快照重構...';

    -- 取得今日日期數字 (例如今日 20260824)
    DECLARE @TodayINT INT = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), GETDATE(), 112) AS INT);

    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#HistoryData') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #HistoryData;
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#CalcResult') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #CalcResult;

    -- A. 抓取最新 5 個交易日歷史
    SELECT * INTO #HistoryData
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            RTRIM(SCH.代號) AS 代號,
            SCH.名稱,
            SCH.日期,
            M.盤中現價,
            M.盤中漲幅,
            M.盤中總量,
            (ISNULL(A.三大法人_ma5, 0) - ISNULL(A.三大法人_ma20, 0)) AS 法人動能棒,
            (ISNULL(SCH.實戰總分, M.專家實戰總分) - ISNULL(SCH.實戰總分_ma20, M.專家實戰總分)) AS 分數動能棒,
            M.k9, M.d9, A.price_ma5, A.price_ma20, A.price_ma60, 
            A.obv淨額, 
            A.obv_ma5 AS obv5, 
            A.obv_ma34 AS obv34,
            ISNULL(A.成交價黃金交叉次數, 0) AS 價格金叉,
            ISNULL(A.obv黃金交叉次數, 0) AS OBV金叉,
            ISNULL(A.總量黃金交叉次數, 0) AS 總量金叉,
            ISNULL(A.投信黃金交叉次數, 0) AS 投信金叉,
            ISNULL(A.外資黃金交叉次數, 0) AS 外資金叉,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SCH.代號 ORDER BY SCH.日期 DESC) AS rn
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.ScoreCrossHistory SCH
        INNER JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis M ON RTRIM(SCH.代號) = RTRIM(M.代號) AND SCH.日期 = M.日期
        LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.allcross A ON RTRIM(SCH.代號) = RTRIM(A.代號) AND SCH.日期 = A.日期
        WHERE M.盤中總量 >= 100
    ) T WHERE rn <= 5;

    CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_H ON #HistoryData (代號, 日期 DESC);

    -- B. 多維度綜合交集計算
    SELECT 
        T1.代號,
        T1.名稱,
        T1.盤中現價 AS 盤中成交價,
        T1.盤中漲幅,
        T1.盤中總量,

        -- 維度 A：雙動能狀態
        CASE 
            WHEN T1.法人動能棒 > 0 AND T2.法人動能棒 <= 0 AND T1.分數動能棒 > 0 AND T2.分數動能棒 <= 0 THEN 2
            WHEN T1.法人動能棒 > T2.法人動能棒 AND T2.法人動能棒 > T3.法人動能棒 AND T1.分數動能棒 > T2.分數動能棒 AND T2.分數動能棒 > T3.分數動能棒 THEN 3
            WHEN T1.法人動能棒 > 0 AND T1.分數動能棒 > 0 THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS DimA_DualMomentum,

        CASE 
            WHEN T1.法人動能棒 > 0 AND T2.法人動能棒 <= 0 AND T1.分數動能棒 > 0 AND T2.分數動能棒 <= 0 THEN N'🔥 雙動能剛由負翻正 (黃金轉折)'
            WHEN T1.法人動能棒 > T2.法人動能棒 AND T2.法人動能棒 > T3.法人動能棒 AND T1.分數動能棒 > T2.分數動能棒 AND T2.分數動能棒 > T3.分數動能棒 THEN N'📈 雙動能連續三日加速擴張'
            WHEN T1.法人動能棒 > 0 AND T1.分數動能棒 > 0 THEN N'🟢 雙動能同時為正'
            ELSE N'☁️ 動能整理中'
        END AS DimA_Status,

        -- 維度 B：OBV 星號狀態
        CASE 
            WHEN (T1.obv5 IS NOT NULL AND T1.obv5 > 0 AND T1.obv淨額 > T1.obv5 * 1.5) OR (T1.obv5 IS NOT NULL AND T1.obv34 IS NOT NULL AND T1.obv淨額 > T1.obv5 AND T1.obv淨額 > T1.obv34) THEN 2
            WHEN T1.obv5 IS NOT NULL AND T1.obv淨額 > T1.obv5 THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS DimB_OBVStar,

        CASE 
            WHEN (T1.obv5 IS NOT NULL AND T1.obv5 > 0 AND T1.obv淨額 > T1.obv5 * 1.5) OR (T1.obv5 IS NOT NULL AND T1.obv34 IS NOT NULL AND T1.obv淨額 > T1.obv5 AND T1.obv淨額 > T1.obv34) THEN N'🌟 巨量金星 (主力暴力建倉)'
            WHEN T1.obv5 IS NOT NULL AND T1.obv淨額 > T1.obv5 THEN N'⭐ 動能初星 (資金暗中點火)'
            ELSE N'⚪ 無星號沉澱期'
        END AS DimB_Status,

        -- 維度 C：K 線三級點火星號
        CASE 
            WHEN T2.盤中現價 <= T2.price_ma60 AND T1.盤中現價 > T1.price_ma60 THEN 3
            WHEN T2.盤中現價 <= T2.price_ma20 AND T1.盤中現價 > T1.price_ma20 THEN 2
            WHEN T2.盤中現價 <= T2.price_ma5 AND T1.盤中現價 > T1.price_ma5 THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS DimC_PriceStar,

        CASE 
            WHEN T2.盤中現價 <= T2.price_ma60 AND T1.盤中現價 > T1.price_ma60 THEN N'✨ 紫光大金星 (強勢突破季線/生命線)'
            WHEN T2.盤中現價 <= T2.price_ma20 AND T1.盤中現價 > T1.price_ma20 THEN N'🌟 橘星 (突破月線攻擊點)'
            WHEN T2.盤中現價 <= T2.price_ma5 AND T1.盤中現價 > T1.price_ma5 THEN N'⭐ 黃星 (突破5MA短線轉強)'
            ELSE N'⛅ 均線整理中'
        END AS DimC_Status,

        -- 維度 D：彩虹金叉總分 (0~40分)
        (T1.價格金叉 + T1.OBV金叉 + T1.總量金叉 + T1.投信金叉 + T1.外資金叉) AS DimD_RainbowScore,
        N'🌈 彩虹共振分: ' + CAST((T1.價格金叉 + T1.OBV金叉 + T1.總量金叉 + T1.投信金叉 + T1.外資金叉) AS NVARCHAR) + N'分' AS DimD_Status

    INTO #CalcResult
    FROM (SELECT * FROM #HistoryData WHERE rn = 1) T1
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM #HistoryData WHERE rn = 2) T2 ON T1.代號 = T2.代號
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM #HistoryData WHERE rn = 3) T3 ON T1.代號 = T3.代號;

    -- C. 原子更新寫入快照實體表 (日期欄位寫入今日計算日期 @TodayINT，對齊 20260824！)
    TRUNCATE TABLE [dbo].[ResonanceMultiFactor_Snapshot];

    INSERT INTO [dbo].[ResonanceMultiFactor_Snapshot] (
        [代號], [名稱], [日期], [盤中成交價], [盤中漲幅], [盤中總量],
        [DimA_DualMomentum], [DimA_Status],
        [DimB_OBVStar], [DimB_Status],
        [DimC_PriceStar], [DimC_Status],
        [DimD_RainbowScore], [DimD_Status],
        [HitCount], [ResonanceTag], [更新時間]
    )
    SELECT 
        代號, 名稱, 
        @TodayINT AS [日期], -- 🛠️【核心對齊】：日期欄位寫入今日計算日期 (例如今日 20260824)！
        盤中成交價, 盤中漲幅, 盤中總量,
        DimA_DualMomentum, DimA_Status,
        DimB_OBVStar, DimB_Status,
        DimC_PriceStar, DimC_Status,
        DimD_RainbowScore, DimD_Status,
        
        (CASE WHEN DimA_DualMomentum > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN DimB_OBVStar > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN DimC_PriceStar > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN DimD_RainbowScore >= 12 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS HitCount,

        CASE 
            WHEN (CASE WHEN DimA_DualMomentum > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN DimB_OBVStar > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN DimC_PriceStar > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN DimD_RainbowScore >= 12 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 4 THEN N'👑 4維全維度共振 (頂級黑馬)'
            WHEN (CASE WHEN DimA_DualMomentum > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN DimB_OBVStar > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN DimC_PriceStar > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN DimD_RainbowScore >= 12 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 3 THEN N'🔥 任3維共振 (起漲發動區域)'
            WHEN (CASE WHEN DimA_DualMomentum > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN DimB_OBVStar > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN DimC_PriceStar > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN DimD_RainbowScore >= 12 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 2 THEN N'⚡ 任2維共振 (轉折伏兵預備)'
            ELSE N'⛅ 單一/無共振'
        END AS ResonanceTag,
        GETDATE()
    FROM #CalcResult;

    PRINT '🎉 全市場 [ResonanceMultiFactor_Snapshot] 多維共振快照重構完成！';

    DROP TABLE #HistoryData;
    DROP TABLE #CalcResult;
END
GO

-- 執行更新
EXEC [dbo].[sp_RefreshMultiResonanceSnapshot];
GO

function executeQuery(autoSelect) {
    let rawSql = $("#sqlText").val();
    let sqlUpper = rawSql.toUpperCase();

    // 🔒【高風險指令攔截】：若包含全市場重算預存程序，強制彈出管理員密碼輸入框！
    const isHeavySP = sqlUpper.includes("SP_RUNWARROOMDAILYREFRESH") || 
                      sqlUpper.includes("SP_CALCINTRADAYSTOCKLIVE_ALL") ||
                      sqlUpper.includes("SP_REFRESHMULTIARSONANCESNAPSHOT");

    if (isHeavySP) {
        Swal.fire({
            title: '🔒 管理員特權驗證',
            text: '您即將發動「全市場大刷新」高風險預存程序 (耗時 20 秒)。請輸入管理員金鑰：',
            input: 'password',
            inputPlaceholder: '請輸入特權金鑰 (例如 2157_ADMIN)...',
            showCancelButton: true,
            confirmButtonText: '🚀 授權執行',
            cancelButtonText: '取消',
            preConfirm: (adminKey) => {
                if (!adminKey) {
                    Swal.showValidationMessage('請輸入管理員金鑰！');
                }
                return adminKey;
            }
        }).then((result) => {
            if (result.isConfirmed) {
                // 通過驗證 ➔ 帶入 2157_ADMIN 發送至後端
                sendAjaxQuery(autoSelect, result.value);
            }
        });
        return; // 中斷常規發送
    }

    // 一般常規查詢 ➔ 帶入預設 2157 執行
    sendAjaxQuery(autoSelect, "2157");
}

// 實際發送 AJAX 函數
function sendAjaxQuery(autoSelect, pwd) {
    let sql = $("#sqlText").val();
    if (autoSelect) sql = "SELECT " + sql;
    const db = $("#useDatabase").val();

    $("#msg").text("⏳ 執行中 (資料庫: " + db + ")...");

    $.ajax({
        type: "POST",
        url: "DataService2.aspx/ExecuteSQL",
        data: JSON.stringify({ sql: sql, db: db, pwd: pwd }), // 帶入動態密碼 (2157 或 2157_ADMIN)
        contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
        dataType: "json",
        timeout: 300000,
        success: function (res) {
            // ... 其餘渲染邏輯保持不變 ...
        }
    });
}

vb
    ' =========================================================================
    ' 🏆【ExecuteSQL WebMethod 安全升級版】
    ' 1. 解除 EXEC 封鎖，支援預存程序執行
    ' 2. 智慧補齊 SELECT，避免 select EXEC 語法衝突
    ' 3. 全市場重算高風險 SP 強制要求 2157_ADMIN 特權密碼防護！
    ' =========================================================================
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function ExecuteSQL(ByVal sql As String, ByVal db As String, ByVal pwd As String) As String

        ' 1. 基礎密碼檢查
        If pwd <> "2157" AndAlso pwd <> "2157_ADMIN" Then
            Return "錯誤：[密碼錯誤] 權限不足，無法執行查詢！"
        End If

        Dim rawSql As String = sql.Trim()
        Dim upperSQL As String = rawSql.ToUpper()

        ' 2. 👑【高風險預存程序特權防線】：全市場大重算指令僅限 2157_ADMIN 特權密碼執行！
        Dim heavySPs As String() = {
            "SP_RUNWARROOMDAILYREFRESH",
            "SP_CALCINTRADAYSTOCKLIVE_ALL",
            "SP_REFRESHMULTIARSONANCESNAPSHOT",
            "SP_REFRESH_STOCKPERSONALITY_3EXITS"
        }

        For Each sp In heavySPs
            If upperSQL.Contains(sp) Then
                ' 若非 2157_ADMIN 特權密碼 ➔ 直接封鎖拒絕！
                If pwd <> "2157_ADMIN" Then
                    Return "錯誤：[權限不足] 預存程序 '" & sp & "' 屬【全市場重算高風險指令】，僅限系統管理員輸入特權金鑰 (2157_ADMIN) 後執行！"
                End If
            End If
        Next

        ' 3. 破壞性 SQL 指令禁詞檢查 (已剔除 EXEC，允許合法執行預存程序)
        Dim forbiddenWords As String() = {"UPDATE", "DELETE", "DROP", "ALTER", "INSERT", "TRUNCATE", "CREATE", "GRANT"}

        For Each word In forbiddenWords
            If upperSQL.Contains(word) Then
                Return "錯誤：指令包含禁止字詞 " & word
            End If
        Next

        ' 4. 智慧補齊 SELECT (若以 EXEC, SELECT, WITH, /* 開頭，絕不重複補齊，防止語法錯誤)
        Dim finalSql As String = rawSql
        If Not upperSQL.StartsWith("SELECT") AndAlso
           Not upperSQL.StartsWith("EXEC") AndAlso
           Not upperSQL.StartsWith("WITH") AndAlso
           Not upperSQL.StartsWith("/*") Then
            finalSql = "SELECT " & rawSql
        End If

        ' 5. 資料庫連線字串動態匹配
        Dim connStr As String = ""
        Select Case db.ToLower().Trim()
            Case "stockchangedate"
                connStr = "Data Source=pc048000110;Initial Catalog=stockchangedate;User ID=excelsql;Password=***"
            Case "favor2"
                connStr = "Data Source=pc048000110;Initial Catalog=favor2;User ID=excelsql;Password=***"
            Case "stockchange"
                connStr = "Data Source=pc048000110;Initial Catalog=stockchange;User ID=excelsql;Password=***"
            Case "stockprice"
                connStr = "Data Source=pc048000110;Initial Catalog=stockprice;User ID=excelsql;Password=***"
            Case "stockinfo"
                connStr = "Data Source=pc048000110;Initial Catalog=stockinfo;User ID=excelsql;Password=***"
            Case "work"
                connStr = "Data Source=pc048000110;Initial Catalog=work;User ID=excelsql;Password=***"
            Case "stockchangefour"
                connStr = "Data Source=pc048000110;Initial Catalog=stockchangefour;User ID=excelsql;Password=***"
            Case "fromaccessdatabase"
                connStr = "Data Source=pc048000110;Initial Catalog=fromaccessdatabase;User ID=excelsql;Password=***"
            Case "pokopoko"
                connStr = "Data Source=pc048000110;Initial Catalog=pokopoko;User ID=excelsql;Password=***"
            Case "wordvoice"
                connStr = "Data Source=pc048000110;Initial Catalog=wordvoice;User ID=excelsql;Password=***"
            Case "poemleg"
                connStr = "Data Source=pc048000110;Initial Catalog=poemleg;User ID=excelsql;Password=***"
            Case "favor1"
                connStr = "Data Source=pc048000110;Initial Catalog=favor1;User ID=excelsql;Password=***"
            Case Else
                connStr = "Data Source=pc048000110;Initial Catalog=stockchangedate;User ID=excelsql;Password=***"
        End Select

        ' 6. 執行 SQL 查詢與 JSON 序列化
        Dim dt As New DataTable()

        Try
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(connStr)
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(finalSql, conn)
                Dim adapter As New SqlDataAdapter(cmd)
                conn.Open()
                adapter.Fill(dt)
            End Using

            ' 將 DataTable 轉為相容 JSON 的清單結構 (處理 Byte() 圖片與 DBNull)
            Dim rows As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()

            For Each dr As DataRow In dt.Rows
                Dim row As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                For Each col As DataColumn In dt.Columns
                    Dim cellValue As Object = dr(col)

                    If Not Convert.IsDBNull(cellValue) AndAlso cellValue.GetType() Is GetType(Byte()) Then
                        row.Add(col.ColumnName, "data:image/png;base64," & Convert.ToBase64String(CType(cellValue, Byte())))
                    Else
                        row.Add(col.ColumnName, If(Convert.IsDBNull(cellValue), Nothing, cellValue))
                    End If
                Next
                rows.Add(row)
            Next

            Return JsonConvert.SerializeObject(rows)

        Catch ex As Exception
            Return "錯誤：" & ex.Message.Replace("""", "'")
        End Try

    End Function

        If isReadOnly Then

            For Each word In forbidden

                End If

                    End If

                    Dim isQuery As Boolean = upperSQL.StartsWith("SELECT") OrElse

                                             upperSQL.StartsWith("WITH") OrElse 
                                             upperSQL.StartsWith("/*") OrElse

    End Function

/* =========================================================================
   🏆 【Zen AI 戰情室大一統一鍵刷新主控程序 V2.0】
   - 自動帶入今日日期 @TargetDate (如 20260824) 給 sp_CalcIntradayStockLive_all！
   ========================================================================= */
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_RunWarRoomDailyRefresh
    @TargetDate INT = NULL -- 選擇性參數：若未傳入，自動計算帶入今日日期 YYYYMMDD
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- 1. 若未傳入日期，自動抓取今日日期數字 (例如 20260824)
    IF @TargetDate IS NULL OR @TargetDate = 0
    BEGIN
        SET @TargetDate = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), GETDATE(), 112) AS INT);
    END

    PRINT '🚀 [1/5] 正在執行全市場即時均線運算 (sp_CalcIntradayStockLive_all @TargetDate=' + CAST(@TargetDate AS VARCHAR) + ')...';
    
    -- 🛠️ 核心修正：將 @TargetDate 正確帶入給 sp_CalcIntradayStockLive_all！
    EXEC dbo.sp_CalcIntradayStockLive_all @TargetDate = @TargetDate;

    PRINT '🚀 [2/5] 正在刷新盤中估分快取表 (sp_RefreshIntradayScoreCache)...';
    EXEC dbo.sp_RefreshIntradayScoreCache;

    PRINT '🚀 [3/5] 正在刷新全市場多維共振快照 (sp_RefreshMultiResonanceSnapshot)...';
    EXEC dbo.sp_RefreshMultiResonanceSnapshot;

    PRINT '🚀 [4/5] 正在刷新 3-Way 離場勝率快照 (sp_Refresh_StockPersonality_3Exits)...';
    EXEC dbo.sp_Refresh_StockPersonality_3Exits;

    PRINT '🚀 [5/5] 正在刷新 AllCross_Snapshot 與 AI 自選股快照...';
    EXEC stockchange.dbo.sp_UpdateAllCrossSnapshot;
    EXEC dbo.sp_RefreshAIWatchlist;

    PRINT '🎉 【大功告成】全戰情室所有快照表已 100% 按正確順序更新完畢！';
END
GO

Finally, the main function executes the batch run. I am ready to move onto the Scheduler setup and the response's structure.
